label: Market Close
headline: S&P -0.3% after -2.7% at midday, Dow +0.3% off a 1,105-point drop, Palo Alto -3.5% after hours
stance: Stocks recovered most of a 4% tech drop by the close. Treasuries kept a 6bp rally after core PCE came in above forecast.

scorecard.call: Morning: Nasdaq futures lower on tariff reports.
scorecard.actual: Right, then reversed. Nasdaq 100 fell more than 4% at the low and closed -0.6%.

scorecard.call: Midday: 10y 4.81%, -10bp, despite core PCE above forecast.

scorecard.actual: Reversed. Gold futures $3,601, +1.1% (~6:32pm ET), off a 14-month low.

sections.title: Macro & Rates
bullets: $44bn 7y auction stopped at 4.708% vs 4.698% when-issued, a 1bp tail (~11:54am ET).
Beige Book: 8 of 12 Fed districts grew, down from 9 in October. Wage pressures picked up (~2:12pm ET).

sections.title: Equity Markets
bullets: Dow was down 1,105 points at its low and closed +0.3%. Russell 2000 +0.7% (~4:24pm ET).
VIX 28.3 at the close, still above 3-month VIX at 26.3. Near-term hedges stay in demand.

sections.title: Credit & Liquidity
bullets: HYG +0.1%, LQD +0.5% at the close. Credit ETFs rose on a down day for the S&P.
South Africa's central bank warned AI borrowing is becoming a bond market risk (~5:34pm ET).

items.head: Palo Alto Networks -3.5% after hours (~6:42pm ET)
items.body: Reports say a former executive accused it of accounting fraud (~4:55pm ET). Stock had closed +0.9%.

items.head: HP Inc +11.5% at the close
items.body: Earnings beat lifted the stock during the tech selloff (~4:36pm ET).

items.head: Nvidia -3.9% at the close, $149.30
items.body: Moody's kept its Aa1 rating but flagged key-person and governance risks (~5:18pm ET).

watch.head: Bank of Korea decision, ~8:00pm ET tonight
watch.body: Last decision of 2026. A rate rise is expected (~4:09pm ET).

watch.head: US markets closed Thursday
watch.body: Thanksgiving. Stocks close early Friday at 1:00, bonds at 2:00.

watch.head: Advance goods trade, Nov 27, 8:30
watch.body: Early read on the goods trade gap and inventories.

watch.head: ISM Manufacturing and JOLTS, Dec 1, 10:00
watch.body: First tier-1 data after the holiday, eight days before the Dec 9 FOMC.
